driverTrip.title: Driver app
driverTrip.none: No trip is assigned to you. The dispatch desk puts you on a trip.
driverTrip.notice: Location notice: during this trip (from start until you close it) the app records your location, at each stop and when you record delivery. It is used only for deliveries, kept 90 days, and never recorded after the trip.
driverTrip.ack: I have read the location notice
driverTrip.startNote: The office's checks run now: every delivery needs its posted invoice and e-way bill, and the goods leave stock when the trip starts.
driverTrip.failReason: Why could it not be delivered?
driverTrip.failNote: Everything for this stop goes back to the dispatch place in quarantine and the order stays open.
driverTrip.closeTitle: Every stop is done · close the trip
driverTrip.closed: Trip closed. Location is no longer recorded.
